image_description: A large, ornate wooden pipe organ situated within a stone arched alcove. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically around a central decorative structure. The casing is made of dark, polished wood with intricate carvings and moldings. A console area is visible in the lower-middle section, though specific keyboards are obscured by shadow and distance.

To check for structural coherence in the intricate wood carvings and ensure boundaries between pipes and wood are sharp and logical.
To detect any subtle texture anomalies or generative artifacts in the wood grain or metallic reflections.
